title: Medik8’s Firewall promises an antioxidant high
summary: Medik8 says its new Firewall Broad Spectrum Super Antioxidant exceeds the performance of its closest competition by at least five times. It’s a bold claim but Medik8 founder, pharmacologist Elliot Isaacs says the claim is backed by science. “We’ve tested our product,” he says. “There’s nothing revolutionary in that other than the fact that we’ve actually we’ve done it. Many products use a lot of great ingredients but for whatever reason they aren’t necessarily working together and the final product isn’t clinically tested.”
